descriptionChirho: The independent second person masculine singular pronoun, used throughout the Hebrew Bible for direct address. All three clusters are identical in meaning: the bare pronoun (eng: you/You, spa: tú/Tú, hin: तू/तूने, arb: أَنْتَ, kor: 네가/너는, swa: wewe), the conjunctive form with waw (eng: and-you/but-you, spa: y-tú/Y-tú, arb: وَ-أَنْتَ, hin: और-तू, swa: na-wewe), and a rare ketiv variant (S85007) that is simply a scribal spelling variant of the same pronoun. Multilingual evidence is perfectly uniform.
